title: The app garden got a few new specimens
summary:
A community-garden day: new apps, cleaner contribution flows, fresh themes, steadier operations, and a site migration underneath it all.

BhaujAI joined hackAndBuild, Asive AI joined chat, and Multi Image Generator joined creative. The community directory now has a single source of truth, alongside refreshed weekly news and four new highlights.

App submission enhancements were restored and the generated contribution PRs now include fuller details, readable formatting, repository links, and valid YAML. Less archaeology for maintainers, more useful context for everyone.

Grayscale and plants theme presets landed, giving builders a pair of new visual defaults: one austere, one chlorophyll-adjacent.
